profile.headline: Software Engineer at Broadcom
profile.summary:
SUMMARY OF QUALIFICATIONS
• Full-Stack developer working on back-end, front-end and anything-in-between technologies that are required to deliver both ad-hoc and production quality solutions.
• 10+ years experience with software design, development and testing.
• 10+ years experience with object oriented programming.
• 10+ years experience with database design and programming.
• Ability to deliver quick scripting solutions written in Bash/Perl/Python/Ruby.
• Passionate for creating software that are robust, well tested, maintainable and easy to extend.
• Perceptive for new technologies, methodologies and tools with a focus on practical applications to make things more easy or robust or simply to get things done.

CURRENT EXPERIENCE
My current experience involves architecture, design, development and maintenance of software and infrastructure for running large performance tests. The software that I create deals with orchestrating, scheduling, running and collecting data that are then further analyzed using web-based tools, visualizations and reports that I develop in collaboration with engineers and analysts of all levels.

SKILLS
Languages: C#, C, SQL, Javascript, Perl, Ruby, Python, Shell, Expect
Web: Django, Falcon, Ruby on Rails, Sinatra, ASP.NET/MVC, Angular, HTML, CSS, jQuery, XML, JSON, Foundation, Bootstrap, C3.js
Database: Postgres, MySQL, MS SQL Server w/ SSIS/SSRS/SSAS, Oracle, NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, Memcached)
Servers: Apache, IIS, nginx
Design Methodologies:	OOP, MVC, DSL, REST, APIs, Design Patterns
Automation: Ansible, Selenium, WatiN, CruiseControl.NET
OS: Windows, Unix, Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Red Hat, CentOS)
Cloud/Virtualization: AWS, Azure, VMWare, Docker
Version Controls: Perforce, SourceSafe, Subversion, Git, Collabnet TeamForge

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed, supported and enhanced software that helps to automate the processes involved in running large numbers of performance measurements, collecting accurate and meaningful performance statistics from these measurements, reporting results and storing them in a database.
• Architected, designed and developed “Isolated VLAN Tool” project, which is a tool that takes care of provisioning VLANs and configuring switch ports of devices that are involved in a performance test.  This resulted in complete isolation of a single performance test within a certain VLAN.  This project involved creation of RESTful API endpoints using Django REST Framework which interfaces directly with devices such as ethernet switches, backup devices and servers.  I developed a Python library that dealt with remotely discovering switch connections and then configuring the respective switch ports. The Management Web UI was developed using AngularJS with authentication via LDAP and MySQL database backend.
• Re-architected parts of the framework to support OpenSSH, programmed a major component that monitors the tests currently in flight, re-designed the test management UI, developed and implemented push deployment strategy of our software to production environments.  I received a platinum award for this effort because this enabled us to continue all our testing efforts while having a major shift in hardening the products that we were testing.
• Ported the software infrastructure such that it can be used entirely within AWS.  This enabled us to run performance tests in AWS environment.
• Enhanced current reporting structure by adding critical maximum sustained throughput metrics and test comparisons. I received an excellence award for this because this gave engineers ability to compare performance results side by side and analyze performance characteristics quickly and accurately.
• Optimized a segment of our data import scripts achieving 10+ times improvement in database imports.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and developed a fully automated reporting framework for displaying performance regression results monitoring various branches and builds against product platforms and protocols.  I received an excellence award for this because this tool enabled engineers to easily track issues and work to be done for every regression that was caught from the automated tests.  
• Developed a dynamic web-based historical report of performance data with a visualization GUI. I received an excellence award for this. This tool enabled engineers to quickly understand, analyze and debug performance issues across different protocols and product platforms. 
• Led the integration of WAN Emulators in the infrastructure, collaborated with network engineers in understanding, analyzing and configuring of the network, programmed and implemented full automation and configuration of WAN emulators.
• Rewrote the software that evaluates performance regressions resulting in 83% run time improvement and 50% decrease in CPU utilization. This enabled us to quickly and more efficiently process regression analysis across different product models, protocols and builds.
• Introduced unit-testing methodologies and strategies for testing the current code base.
• Investigated and assisted in the resolution of issues related to the performance test automation software and underlying infrastructure used by both the performance verification team and the broader product development community in EMC’s Backup and Recovery Systems division.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a robust and secure web based application front-end that is accessed by 300+ users every month.
• Setup from scratch a complete continuous integration, build and release system for R&D.
• Developed a secure web-based document generator for creating and storing legal documents.
• Designed a SharePoint 2010 based application that creates legal documents in PDF format.
• Developed a secure customer analysis web based tool that is designed to create large excel files asynchronously in the background while simultaneously being stored in a database. In this project, I received a Recognition Award for quickly delivering a mission-critical solution for the business.
• Extended a fully automated system that gathers sales data from various enterprise systems.
• Wrote web based SOX(Sarbanes Oxley) compliance tools that interface directly with AD and LDAP.

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst
positions.description:
• Created a web based graphical dashboard visualizing IT Service Management metrics and key performance indicators.
• Designed and developed a global reporting system prototype for IT Service Management using SQL Server Business Intelligence Suite consisting of SSAS, SSIS and Reporting Services.
• Developed a software and asset management system interfacing with SMS and CMDB.

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst/Tool Developer/Tivoli Programmer
positions.description:
• Created a web based reporting system for IT customer billing.
• Authored various automation scripts for migration, installation, de-installation of software.
• Wrote scripts for Tivoli administration, data maintenance and package deployment.
• Assisted in several major migrations, divestitures, mergers and acquisition activities within IT as a programmer and systems expert.
